data.label: IAM roles (Lambda + ECS)
data.notes: exam-notifier-role: ses:SendEmail (invoked by S3, no queue polling). exam-marker-role: same SQS actions on marking-queue. Both trust lambda.amazonaws.com.

data.description: 1. Student opens exams.uni.edu; PUT /api/attempts/{id}/answers every 30 s
3. WAF checks request; /api/* goes to the load balancer
4. Load balancer sends it to a healthy API task
5. API saves the answers in the database
AZ-a down: traffic goes to the load balancer in AZ-b
Standby has become the primary after failover
1. Browser uploads the 40 MB file straight to S3 (presigned URL)
2. S3 'file uploaded' event invokes the notifier Lambda (asynchronous)
3. Lambda calls SES SendEmail (email delivery is not simulated by the Lab)
Sign in, get a token with role = student
Before uploading: API gives a presigned URL (checks PDF/ZIP, <= 50 MB, deadline)
Multi-AZ: every write copied to the standby
